sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Prevent accidental pass on missing or ambiguous orientation: add sh:minCount 1 and sh:maxCount 1 to nltl:memberNormalToPlating while retaining the false-value evidence condition. Also make each QuantityValue unambiguous by adding sh:maxCount 1 to qudt:numericValue and qudt:unit; otherwise a quantity carrying the required unit alongside conflicting units can pass sh:hasValue.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The shape targets only nltl:iceStringer, but the requirement applies to frames, stringers, and web frames governed by sections 4.4, 4.5, and 4.6. Locate the canonical classes for the missing frame and web-frame categories and add them as targets (or create equivalent shapes for them), while retaining the effective-cross-section constraints and the not-normal conditional evidence check for every applicable member category.

Applicability is incomplete: the requirement covers frames, stringers, and web frames, but the shape targets only iceStringer and webFrame. Locate the canonical class for the applicable frames and add it as a target while retaining the stringer and web-frame targets; apply the same effective-cross-section and conditional classification-society evidence constraints to all three member categories.

Prevent accidental pass on missing or ambiguous orientation: add sh:minCount 1 and sh:maxCount 1 to nltl:memberNormalToPlating while retaining the false-value evidence condition. Also make each QuantityValue unambiguous by adding sh:maxCount 1 to qudt:numericValue and qudt:unit; otherwise a quantity carrying the required unit alongside conflicting units can pass sh:hasValue.
